summary: Family Movie Night at the Park took place at Elmwood Park on September 15, 2023, turning an open field into an outdoor cinema run by the local community center under organizer Maria Gonzalez. The evening paired an animated feature with talks by filmmaker James Richardson, a Q&A with student filmmakers, a Youth Filmmaker Showcase, and a technology mini-exhibit. Mayor Thompson and local sponsors backed the event, and the film society announced scholarships for budding filmmakers.
one_line: Elmwood Park's September 15, 2023 Family Movie Night mixed an outdoor film screening with youth filmmaker showcases, mentoring talks, and community and sponsor support.
key_facts: Family Movie Night at the Park was held at Elmwood Park on September 15, 2023, at dusk, with an open field turned into an open-air cinema.
The event was organized by the local community center, led by organizer Maria Gonzalez, who has spent years in the film industry.
Maria Gonzalez said, "Cinema has the power to not only entertain but educate and inspire."
The night opened with an animated feature film, chosen to spark creativity in younger minds and depict the importance of following one's dreams.
Local filmmaker James Richardson, known for award-winning independent films, gave a short speech before the movie about the journey of film-making.
After the movie, local student filmmakers who had recently won a regional competition held an open Q&A session.
Julie Chen, 17, said movie nights like these were her classroom outside of school.
The 'Youth Filmmaker Showcase' screened short films by local young talents after the feature, with themes from friendship to the environment.
Ten-year-old Elijah Watson's stop-motion tale using action figures and his parents' backyard won hearts at the showcase.
Maria Gonzalez and her team ran a mini-exhibit teaching drone filming, animation on tablets, and editing software.
Mayor Thompson attended with his family and said the event is about community engagement and giving youth a platform to believe in themselves.
Local businesses supported the event: a local bakery provided complimentary sweets and a tech store offered discounts on film equipment.
The local film society announced scholarships for budding filmmakers.
